label: Auto surfaces
tooltip: Turn an organic scan into B-spline surfaces and a solid body automatically.
help: For organic shapes without regular geometry. A control cage is fitted to the scan; every quad becomes a B-spline surface, and for a closed scan all surfaces together form a valid body. Fine follows the scan more closely but takes longer and gives more surfaces; more smoothing calms noisy scans. Close open scans with Fill holes first.
selectionMissing: Mark triangles with the brush or face selection (at least {{min}}).
